description: Inspect a website's sitemap. Discovers sitemap URLs, parses sitemap XML, and returns listed page URLs with last-modified dates and change frequencies.

render.description: Rendering mode. 'never' = fast static fetch (1 credit). 'auto' = static first, browser if needed. 'always' = browser rendering (5 credits).

url.description: Website URL or direct sitemap URL

name: tooltrace_sitemap
